label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_00
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]……\n我們是第一次在社辦見面呢。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_02
text: 啊嘎嘶在那之後都還好嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_select_01
text: 牠很有活力！

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_select_02
text: 牠常常飛來飛去！

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_04
text: 牠吃了那麼大量的那個藥丸，\n納莉我有些擔心。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_05
text: 我猜是因為啊嘎嘶的身體強壯，\n所以才能安然無恙吧。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_06
text: 用其他寶可夢嘗試的話，\n應該會有一些危險。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_07
text: 飛翔計時賽通常是\n騎著盔甲鳥來進行的。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_08
text: 納莉我想告訴[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的事就是這些。\n我們結束對話吧。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_01
text: 請問[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是如何和\n烏栗認識的？[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_select_01
text: 在夏令營！

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_select_02
text: 我們是一隊

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_02
text: 有那樣的活動……\c\n的確，在他變了個人之前\n是有回去北上。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_02b
text:
一、一對！？
……抱、抱歉。\c
你們是兩人組成一隊，
去完成了夏令營的課題，是吧。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_03
text: 烏栗他對[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳\n抱持著強烈情感的理由……\r\n讓納莉我很在意。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_04
text: ……看來問題不在\n你們是如何認識的。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_05
text: 納莉我想問的已經問完了。\n謝謝。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_01
text: 最近……\n納莉我不太對勁。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_02
text: 有時胸口鬱悶，\n並且食慾不振。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_03
text: 但是去醫務室檢查，\n也沒有任何異常。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_04
text: 該不會納莉我身上\n正在發生什麼嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_select_01
text: 有頭緒嗎？

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_select_02
text: 什麼時候會發生？

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_05
text: 納莉我完全沒有頭緒。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_05b
text: 完全沒有規律性。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_06
text: 硬要說的話……\n當納莉我在想烏栗的時候，\r\n會出現這個症狀……[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_07
text: 但納莉我認為這兩件事\n並沒有任何因果關係。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_01_00
text: 納莉我確認到和[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳\n對話之後，症狀有所舒緩。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_01_02
text: 為了證明這項假設，\n納莉我提議來交換寶可夢。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_01_03
text: 感謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳爽快地答應。\n納莉我選拔出了盔甲鳥。\r\n正在等待[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的選擇。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_02_01
text: 初訓家不是自己的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_02_02
text: 稀有的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_02_03
text: 異色的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_03_00
text:
同行的寶可夢只有１隻時，
不可交換。\c
同行的寶可夢有２隻以上時，
可以交換。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_04_00
text: 納莉我再次提議\n來交換寶可夢。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_talkto_00
text: 要和納莉我開始戰鬥嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battlestart_00
text: 我們更換地點。\n……請一起來。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battlestart_01
text:
在本學園，
應當進行雙打對戰。\c
納莉我建議[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳帶著
２隻以上的同行寶可夢。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_00_01
text: 和[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳戰鬥時，\n心情總是能夠安穩平靜。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_00_02
text: 作為謝禮，納莉我傳授給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳\n納莉我知道的最強必殺技。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_00_03
text: ……這是丹瑜教納莉我的。\c\n據她說只要做這個姿勢，\n就能立刻擊倒對手。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_reward_00
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]從納莉那裡\n學會了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]手指愛心表情[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_randomtalk_00
text: 時間有限。\n要珍惜每分每秒。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_randomtalk_01
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，怎麼了？\c\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳很在意納莉我\n這副高品味的眼鏡嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_randomtalk_04
text:
納莉我的盔甲鳥
在沉重球裡面。\c
那是顆很美的球，
性能和設計都和鋼屬性相襯。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
